sections.content: Review the unit: ask milyen? and answer with an adjective, optionally strengthened with nagyon, remembering the -k plural predicate rule.
sections.title: Unit review

items.spanish: Milyen ő? Nagyon kicsi, de erős.
items.english: What is he like? Very small, but strong.

items.spanish: Milyen az ember? A férfi magas, a nő alacsony.
items.english: What is the person like? The man is tall, the woman is short.

sections.content: de ('but') contrasts two qualities in one sentence — Kicsi, de erős (Small, but strong) — a simple glue word that makes descriptions much richer.
